endorsements.name: Grzegorz Misiun
endorsements.label: CVE-2024-32046
endorsements.description: Mattermost versions 9.6.x <= 9.6.0, 9.5.x <= 9.5.2, 9.4.x <= 9.4.4 and 8.1.x <= 8.1.11 fail to remove detailed error messages in API requests even if the developer mode is off which allows an attacker to get information about the server such as the full path were files are stored
endorsements.subtitle: CVE · Severity: MEDIUM (CVSS 3.1, 4.3)

endorsements.name: Grzegorz Misiun
endorsements.label: CVE-2024-5270
endorsements.description: Mattermost versions 9.5.x <= 9.5.3, 9.7.x <= 9.7.1, 9.6.x <= 9.6.1 and 8.1.x <= 8.1.12 fail to check if the email signup configuration option is enabled when a user requests to switch from SAML to Email. This allows the user to switch their authentication mail from SAML to email and possibly edit personal details that were otherwise non-editable and provided by the SAML provider.
endorsements.subtitle: CVE · Severity: MEDIUM (CVSS 3.1, 4.3)
